teaser.en: A caper bush that Digo lump with an acacia under one name, simply because both claw at you the same way.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha jamii ya caper ambacho Wadigo hukiweka pamoja na mgunga chini ya jina moja, kwa sababu tu vyote viwili hukukwaruza kwa njia ile ile.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha *caper* ambacho Adigo anachiika phamwenga na *acacia* kpwa dzina mwenga, kpwa sababu tu viiri vinakugbwira kpwa miya dza kombe.

summary.en: This scrambling caper bush shares the name *chikombe tsui*, 'leopard's claws', with a thorny acacia. The two are grouped for their hooked thorns, not because they are related or used the same way.
summary.sw: Kichaka hiki kinachotambaa cha jamii ya caper kinashiriki jina *chikombe tsui*, 'makucha ya chui', na mgunga wenye miiba. Viwili hivi vimewekwa pamoja kwa sababu ya miiba yao iliyopinda kama ndoano, si kwa sababu vina uhusiano wala vinatumika kwa njia moja.
summary.dg: Chitsaka hichi cha *caper* chinachoambala chinaihwa *chikombe tsui*, 'kombe za tsui', sawa na *acacia* yenye miya. Viiri vinaikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya miya yao iriyomyoka, si kpwa sababu ni ndugu wala kpwa sababu vinahumirwa kpwa njira mwenga.

about.en: *Capparis viminea* is a scrambling or climbing shrub of the caper family. It has pairs of short, hooked spines at the base of the leaf stalks and simple, leathery leaves. Its white flowers have a showy brush of long stamens, and its fruits are small, round berries. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Capparis viminea* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, cha familia ya caper. Kina jozi za miiba mifupi iliyopinda kama ndoano kwenye kitako cha vikonyo vya majani, na majani sahili yaliyo magumu kama ngozi. Maua yake meupe yana kishungi cha kuvutia cha stameni ndefu, na matunda yake ni beri ndogo za mviringo. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Capparis viminea* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *caper* chinachoambala au chinachokpwera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. China miya mifupi iriyomyoka, jozi-jozi, kotsi ya mlita wa chila kodza, na makodza ga kawaida mafu dza chingo. Maruwage mereru gana stameni nyire nyinji zinazoonekana sana dza chifungu cha nyuzi, na matundage ni madide, ga duara na genye nyama. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka na matsaka mafupi ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia explains that Digo sometimes group plants from completely different families under one name. *Chikombe tsui* covers this caper bush and the acacia *Acacia adenocalyx* because both carry claw-like thorns. Plants grouped by shape like this are not used in the same way, unlike groups based on a shared use.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba wakati mwingine Wadigo huweka mimea ya familia tofauti kabisa chini ya jina moja. *Chikombe tsui* linajumuisha kichaka hiki cha jamii ya caper na mgunga *Acacia adenocalyx* kwa sababu vyote viwili vina miiba kama makucha. Mimea inayowekwa pamoja kwa umbo kama hivi haitumiki kwa njia moja, tofauti na makundi yanayotokana na matumizi yanayofanana.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala wakati wanjina Adigo anaika mimea ya jamii tafwauti kabisa phamwenga kpwa dzina mwenga. *Chikombe tsui* rinahumirwa kpwa chitsaka hichi cha *caper* na kpwa *acacia*, *Acacia adenocalyx*, kpwa sababu viiri vina miya dza kombe. Mimea inayoikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya umbo dza hivi taihumirwa kpwa njira mwenga, tafwauti na makundi ganagoikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya matumizi mamwenga.

names.en: *Chikombe tsui* means 'claws of a leopard': the thorns are likened to the claws (*kombe*) of a leopard (*tsui*). Swahili shares the name. No English common name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chikombe tsui* maana yake ni 'makucha ya chui': miiba inafananishwa na makucha (*kombe*) ya chui (*tsui*). Kiswahili kinashiriki jina hili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chikombe tsui* manage ni 'kombe za tsui': miya ni dza kombe (*kombe*) za tsui (*tsui*). Chiswahili nacho china dzina hiri. Takuna dzina ra kawaida ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
